summary: Make Desktop teardown one-way so macOS reopen, deep links, and second launches cannot recreate a window against services that are already shutting down.

reactNativeIos.reason: React Native/iOS does not run Electron's before-quit, activate, open-url, BrowserWindow, or single-instance lifecycle and shares no changed code with this Desktop process guard.

nativeAndroid.reason: Native Android has its own Activity/process lifecycle and does not run Electron's quit coordinator or window-reactivation handlers.

sharedBackendApi.reason: The change only orders local Desktop teardown and window activation; IPC channels, WebSocket messages, provider events, and remote-client semantics are unchanged.

storageDataMigration.reason: No schema, stored value, path, or migration changes. The existing awaited database close remains in the same exactly-once teardown and direct v0.8.35/v0.8.47 upgrades retain their prior data path.

notExercised: The original native crash was captured on macOS in Electron's AppKit reopen stack; an automated native crash injection is not available, so regression coverage exercises the lifecycle state machine and every app reactivation wiring path.
Windows does not receive macOS activate events, but its second-instance path is guarded and release CI packages it; a local Windows installer run is not exercised.
React Native/iOS and native Android hardware checks are not applicable because their lifecycle implementations are untouched.
